indicator_name: Return on assets, deposit takers (IMF FSI)
description: Рентабельность активов депозитных организаций, % годовых (МВФ FSI)
methodology: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators (dataflow IMF.STA/FSIC), core indicators for deposit takers, reported by the Kazakh authorities (NBK, then ARDFM), quarterly. Return on assets, % a year, deposit takers. Equal to NBK BANK_ROA shifted one quarter.
